Write a detailed commit message based only on the actual diff.

Use a concise imperative subject line, ideally under 72 characters, followed by a structured body with exactly these sections:

Intent:
Explain why the change was made and what problem it solves.

Changes:

- Describe added, modified, or removed functionality.
- Summarize the most important technical implementation details.

Impact:
Describe notable behavior, user-experience, API, or configuration changes.

Avoid vague wording, implementation-only descriptions, unnecessary file-by-file lists, and claims about changes that are not present in the diff.
